typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		APPL_ID_CT as string,
		USER_CT as string,
		RPT_DT as timestamp,
		DB_OBJ_CT as integer,
		CNTCT_AU_NUM as string,
		CURRENT_PERM_SPACE_GB as string,
		CNTCT_EMAIL_ADDR as string,
		LAST_TBL_DDL_CREATE_DT as timestamp,
		LAST_TBL_DDL_ALTER_DT as timestamp,
		USER_NAME as string,
		TBL_CT as string,
		ENVRN_TXT as string,
		CREATE_DT as timestamp,
		LAST_QRY_DT as timestamp,
		PLTFM_TXT as string,
		MAX_PERM_SPACE_GB as string,
		DATABASENAME as string,
		CONTACT_EMP_ID as string,
		REC_CT as string,
		ENCRYPT_CD as string,
		NON_US_BASED_USER_CT as string,
		QRY_CT as string,
		CNTCT_FULL_NAME as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'with sb as (   select o.*, dense_rank () over (order by RPT_DT desc) rn   from AWB_SCHEMA."SandboxFeed" o ) select DATABASENAME   , RPT_DT   , PLTFM_TXT   , ENVRN_TXT   , CREATE_DT   , ENCRYPT_CD   , USER_CT   , APPL_ID_CT   , NON_US_BASED_USER_CT   , DB_OBJ_CT   , TBL_CT   , QRY_CT   , LAST_QRY_DT   , MAX_PERM_SPACE_GB   , CURRENT_PERM_SPACE_GB   , REC_CT   , LAST_TBL_DDL_CREATE_DT   , LAST_TBL_DDL_ALTER_DT   , CONTACT_EMP_ID   , CNTCT_FULL_NAME   , USER_NAME   , CNTCT_EMAIL_ADDR   , CNTCT_AU_NUM   , CONTACT_LOB from sb where rn <= 3',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource sink(input(
		APPL_ID_CT as string,
		USER_CT as string,
		RPT_DT as string,
		DB_OBJ_CT as string,
		CNTCT_AU_NUM as string,
		CURRENT_PERM_SPACE_GB as string,
		CNTCT_EMAIL_ADDR as string,
		LAST_TBL_DDL_CREATE_DT as string,
		LAST_TBL_DDL_ALTER_DT as string,
		USER_NAME as string,
		TBL_CT as string,
		ENVRN_TXT as string,
		CREATE_DT as string,
		LAST_QRY_DT as string,
		PLTFM_TXT as string,
		MAX_PERM_SPACE_GB as string,
		DATABASENAME as string,
		CONTACT_EMP_ID as string,
		REC_CT as string,
		ENCRYPT_CD as string,
		NON_US_BASED_USER_CT as string,
		QRY_CT as string,
		CNTCT_FULL_NAME as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		APPL_ID_CT,
		USER_CT,
		RPT_DT,
		DB_OBJ_CT,
		CNTCT_AU_NUM,
		CURRENT_PERM_SPACE_GB,
		CNTCT_EMAIL_ADDR,
		LAST_TBL_DDL_CREATE_DT,
		LAST_TBL_DDL_ALTER_DT,
		USER_NAME,
		TBL_CT,
		ENVRN_TXT,
		CREATE_DT,
		LAST_QRY_DT,
		PLTFM_TXT,
		MAX_PERM_SPACE_GB,
		DATABASENAME,
		CONTACT_EMP_ID,
		REC_CT,
		ENCRYPT_CD,
		NON_US_BASED_USER_CT,
		QRY_CT,
		CNTCT_FULL_NAME),
	partitionFileNames:['$OLEDBDestination_outputfilename'],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
